what: Terminal-state writer depends on shared safe-value validation, but the plan defines no callable helper API
scenario_or_breakage: design-stage-terminal-state.sh either duplicates stall-recovery-report.sh vocab validation or cannot reject unknown design tokens, violating the no forked helper requirement
suggested_fix: Define the exact shared validation surface, for example a generic validate-terminal-state or validate-token path, or move that validation to the report gate and remove staging-time shared-layer claims

what: Operator-action chat audit can be written to a sidecar without any render hook
scenario_or_breakage: Validator Cancel or operator-action teardown can set the sentinel and skip filing, but the required chat-visible audit may never be emitted
suggested_fix: Choose one chat path and wire it explicitly: include the audit in final-summary notes or print a named sanitized sidecar after the summary, with render-final-summary coverage

what: Step 5c hard publish-tail routing is unverified
scenario_or_breakage: The new _publish_rc 2 or unexpected path can skip failed-publish-tail reporting or pollute the Step 5c KV stdout contract without a focused test
suggested_fix: Add focused coverage for design-step5c.sh that stubs rc 2 and unexpected rc, asserts failed-publish-tail staging and final-summary routing, and asserts stdout stays KV-only
